business_summary: Unilumin Group Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of LED display and lighting products in China and internationally. It offers professional, commercial, outdoor, rental, creative, and UTV LED products; and professional and commercial display, smart conference, sports venues and events, rental and staging, media architecture, and functional lighting solutions. The company also provides maintenance services, troubleshooting, spare parts, precision maintenance, preventive check, installation, training program, and upgrade. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Unilumin Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Unilumin Group Co., Ltd in January 2010. Unilumin Group Co., Ltd was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
